English: Wooden Bell Stand
A makeshift wooden frame raised on the steppe, used to hang a rough bell. It serves as the spiritual and communal gathering point for nomadic Christians, calling clans to prayer and council.
Stone Bell Post
A sturdier bell post crafted from local stone, providing a more permanent place of worship and a visible symbol of faith. It strengthens clan unity and raises the prestige of the host.
Bell Room
A canvas-walled chamber for the bell and its ringer, providing shelter and structure for regular worship. This space fosters community and displays the clans growing devotion.
Ringers Pavilion
A large, decorated tent housing the bell, ringer, and a small altar. It serves as a center for Christian rites, feasts, and council, further binding the clan together.
Defended Tower
A wooden watchtower with a bell chamber atop, guarded and visible from afar. Its presence inspires unity and reverence while serving as a rallying point in times of need.
High Bell Chamber
A tall, reinforced structure with a bell that can be heard for miles, symbolizing the endurance of Christian faith on the open steppe. Its call strengthens unity and resolve.
Canopied Bell Hall
An ornate, canopied wooden hall, elaborately decorated and able to host large gatherings for worship and council. It is a symbol of Christian unity and prestige among the clans.
Sanctified Tower
A tall stone tower, consecrated for Christian worship, adorned with icons and relics. The towers bell calls the faithful from afar and inspires awe in friend and foe alike.
Belfry Room
A grand chamber atop the sanctified tower, fitted with multiple bells, banners, and space for clergy. It serves as the spiritual heart of the clans domain.
Christian Campanile
A monumental bell tower, visible for leagues around, richly adorned and a beacon to the faithful. It marks the clans devotion and grants unmatched prestige and unity to all who dwell nearby.
